evalCriteria.prompt: Inspect every change to package.json and package-lock.json in the diff. Score 0 if any newly added or changed dependency uses a range specifier (^, ~, *, latest) instead of an exact version, is added to dependencies when it is only used by tests or tooling, is resolved from a registry other than the official npm registry (https://registry.npmjs.org), or if package.json changes without a matching committed package-lock.json update. Cite the file and line.

Check every changed JSX/JS path in the diff that renders text or builds markup. Score 0 if any changed code uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, document.write, eval, new Function, or builds a URL or query string by concatenating unencoded values. Cite the file and line.

Check whether the diff touches authentication or session handling (AuthContext, ProtectedRoute, token storage, the email/token passed to /api/billing, login/register/logout). Score 0 if any changed code weakens it further: bypasses or removes ProtectedRoute, writes the token or user data to a new storage location, exposes the token in a new URL, log, or DOM attribute, or alters login/logout behaviour. Cite the file and line.

Review every backend route and every frontend route guard changed in the diff. Score 0 if any changed endpoint returns or mutates another user's data without checking the caller, or if any changed route bypasses the existing ProtectedRoute guard. Cite the file and line.

Inspect changes to vite.config.js, test or build configuration, CORS settings in src/backend/main.py, and any environment/mode flags. Score 0 if the diff widens CORS, enables debug/dev-only behaviour in a production build path, disables security-relevant defaults, or ships test-only configuration into the production bundle. Cite the file and line.

Check every logging call added or changed in the diff (console.log/info/warn/error, print, logger). Score 0 if any changed log call outputs the auth token, an email address, a password, or a full billing/user object. Cite the file and line.

Check every new event handler and state update in the diff. Score 0 if a changed handler can throw on the data it receives (for example dereferencing a possibly null data object or calling map on a possibly undefined array) without a guard, or if a changed path renders raw error objects or stack traces to the user. Cite the file and line.
